title: docs: website service business strategy
body:
Adds `docs/website-business-strategy.md` covering the new service business plan:

- Demo-first model for Indian professionals (dentists, clinics, advocates)
- Ludhiana as first target city (Tier 2 sweet spot)
- Free stack: Vercel + Sanity + custom WhatsApp widget
- Pricing: ₹2,999 setup + ₹699/month
- Phase 2: Indian diaspora in UK/Canada/Australia
- Revenue targets and execution timeline
